subject: Invitation to Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued supporters, we are delighted to invite you to our Annual Charity Gala on Saturday, November 20th at the Grand Ballroom. Join us for an evening of elegance, fine dining, and entertainment in support of our cause. Your attendance will help us make a meaningful impact in the community. Please RSVP by October 30th to secure your seat. We look forward to celebrating with you!
